test_title: PYST 32: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: And so, we compiled this list through conversations with collegues and social media crowdsourcing.
And so, we compiled this list through conversations with colleagues and social media crowdsourcing.
And so, we compiled this list through conversations with colleagues and social medea crowdsourcing.
And so, we compiled this list through convursations with colleagues and social media crowdsourcing.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"colleagues"** refers to people with whom one works, especially in a profession or business. (सहकर्मी)

 
 
• **Example:** My** colleagues** and I are working on a new project.
 
 
 
• **"Colleagues"** is the correct word and it is spelled correctly. (सहकर्मी)
 
 
• **Example:** He had a good relationship with his **colleagues.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Collegues** (सहकर्मी): This is a misspelling of "colleagues".

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: My collegues are very supportive.
 
 
 
• **Medea** (मीडिया): This is a misspelling of "media".
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: Social medea platforms are very popular.
 
 
 
• **Convursations** (बातचीत): This is a misspelling of "conversations".
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: We had several convursations about the project.
 
 

 

36:Tbde,

The correct answer is: Option 3.</
